log_file.description: Path to the PostgreSQL log file or replay file to process.

db_host.description: Target database host (PGHOST). Empty string uses local socket.

db_password.description: Password for database authentication (-W). Empty string implies trust.

speed_factor.description: Speed factor for replay (-s). >1 fast forward, <1 slow motion.

start_time.description: Start timestamp filter (-b). Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.FFF.

end_time.description: End timestamp filter (-e). Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.FFF.

outfile.description: Output replay file name (-o) for parse mode. Empty for replay mode.

escape_quotes.description: Escape backslash in literals (-q) for older server versions.
